videos.title: There are many futures. Which do you want to build?
How Gen uses ChatGPT Work to turn data Into decisions | OpenAI
videos.description:
“Before ChatGPT Work, we were walking. Now with ChatGPT Work, we are running.”

For Gen's Howie Xu, that means understanding how a new product’s onboarding experience is working within two or three hours of release.

Finding answers used to mean repeated handoffs across teams, functions, and time zones. ChatGPT Work is shortening that feedback loop.

Watch how Howie turns business data into decisions while the work is still happening.

videos.title: Solo Stamina Nightblade Build Making and Testing | Tanking Trials in Group Finder | ESO Livestream
ESO Update 52 PTS Patch Notes - AoE Taunts, Tank Damage & Templar Changes
videos.description:
ESO Update 52 PTS Patch Notes breakdown. Update 52 brings AoE taunts, damage bonuses for tanks, a lot of Templar changes, a new PvP zone called Jerall Pass, and a new World Event called Rimegales.

I also found several changes that ZOS didn't mention in the patch notes, such as the Nightblade Cowardice changes. I'm showing the full live and PTS tooltips, so you can see exactly what changed.

Written breakdown - https://hyperioxes.com/eso/news/update-52-pts-patch-notes
Tank damage changes pushed to the limit - https://youtu.be/MWt-ytgfo0Q
